relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: gain-of-function mutations in Nav1.7 can lead to chronic spontaneous pain or extreme pain symptoms, such as inherited erythromelalgia (IEM)

relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: loss-of-function mutations in Nav1.7 result in congenital insensitivity to pain (CIP)

relationships.subject: vixotrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: vixotrigine did not affect the activation properties of Nav1.7 but promoted its inactivation by stabilizing the inactivated state

relationships.subject: PF-05089771
relationships.evidence_quote: Pfizer’s PF-05089771, a highly selective Nav1.7 inhibitor

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: As a selective Nav1.8 inhibitor, VX-548 was designed specifically for the treatment of moderate to severe acute pain

key_findings: Review of Nav1.7, Nav1.8 and Nav1.9 as analgesic targets; Nav1.7 inhibitors have largely failed clinically while Nav1.8 inhibitor suzetrigine (VX-548) advanced.
Combined inhibition of multiple Nav subtypes and improved selectivity are proposed for future non-opioid analgesics.
